content: Screenshot/video artifact growth is a structural cost in agentic E2E: every step produces images plus optional video, so runs generate hundreds of MBs. Playwright-style trace retention and CI artifact expiry are the standard controls: tiered retention (full evidence short-lived, summarized evidence long-lived, facts forever in DB), immediate transcode/compress, store in object storage with lifecycle rules rather than in app DB, and keep reports as links not embedded blobs.
